general.description: AG-18 was once a research station and laboratory from the Globecorp Company. It was a secretive place until the revelation of the infamous Hunchbacks' affair. It was revealed by a whistleblower that the company worked on sentient Biomechas, using Human ADN. When journalists rushed on the place, no proofs where found, but the reputation of Globecorp was already tarnished. Nowadays, the station was abaonned for years, and become a place for squatters and spaceurbex. Very recently, the place have been reclaimed by some new owner.
general.bar: The Halls of AG-18 are in heavy remedial works, so there is mainly construction workers, but the old walls of the station retains fantoms of the past... and their whispers are terrifying.
